writer.subject: Harbor beta decisions and Monday follow-ups
writer.body:
Hi team,

Tuesday’s Harbor beta is internal-only, with a read-only dashboard and CSV export off. Partner invites stay in draft pending the invoice retry check.

Amina will update the handoff by Monday at 16:00 UTC. José will post the retry check by 18:00 UTC. The synthetic-account screenshot is unassigned. Late retries may look like duplicate charges, and Finance still needs to tell us whether partner invites require its approval.
